title: Screenshot to Clipboard
body:
# Screenshot to Clipboard

> **Press F2. Ctrl + V. Screenshot shared.**

No searching in the `screenshots` folder.  
No drag & drop.  
No “wait, where was the image saved?”

This mod automatically copies every Minecraft screenshot to your clipboard, while Minecraft still saves it normally as a file.

## What happens?

| You do... | The mod does... |
|---|---|
| `F2` screenshot | saves the image normally |
| right after that `Ctrl + V` | instantly pastes the screenshot |
| Discord, browser, chat, bug report | image is ready to share |

## Perfect for

- quickly showing builds
- reporting bugs
- directly posting funny moments
- screenshots without clicking through folders

```text
Screenshot -> Clipboard -> Paste -> Done
